title: Why does amix make my audio quieter, and why does the level jump?
fullTitle: FFmpeg amix Drops Each Input 6 dB, Then Jumps Up When One Ends

scenes.narration: You mix two tracks with amix. The mix is quieter than either track alone. Then, when the shorter track ends, the level jumps. We make sine tones at minus six d b full scale, one of them half as long, and measure each tone in the output.

Tone A is four forty hertz, six seconds. Tone B is six sixty hertz, three seconds. Reader one is a narrow band pass around each tone, then astats, in half second windows. Reader two is a Goertzel on the raw samples, in Node. Both read each source, and one input through amix, at minus six point zero zero.
captions: A: 440 Hz, 6 s. B: 660 Hz, 3 s. -6 dBFS.

scenes.narration: With default amix, each tone comes out at minus twelve point zero two, six d b down. With three inputs, minus fifteen point five four each. That matches one over the number of inputs. The control: the same tone twice comes back as exactly one input, with error zero.

At three seconds, tone B ends. Tone A rises from minus twelve point zero two to minus six point zero zero: plus six point zero two d b. It takes the two second dropout transition, so it is back at five seconds. Set it to zero and it jumps at three. One second: back at four.
captions: B ends at 3 s: A rises 6.02 dB.
dropout_transition sets how long it takes.

scenes.narration: Add normalize equals zero and nothing is scaled. Each tone stays at minus six, and there is no jump. But amix now just sums. Two tones at minus three d b peak at plus two point six d b, and in sixteen bit, eighteen point four percent of the samples sit at full scale. The default peaks at minus three point four two.
captions: But the sum clips: 18.4% at full scale.

scenes.narration: Weights two one give minus nine point five two and minus fifteen point five four. Duration shortest stops at three seconds, so there is no jump. Pick your trade: quieter, a level change, or headroom. Not tested: other ffmpeg builds, real music, a limiter.
captions: Quieter, a jump, or headroom: pick.
Not tested: real music, other builds.
